'''Zank Helrott''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who served [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He had a reputation of never bringing in a bounty alive. He was sent by Rogun to find [[Voidhound|Ace]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and was to bring the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] back to him in pieces. When he attempted to capture the smuggler aboard [[Drooga's pleasure barge]], the wookiee [[Bowdaar]] stepped in, returning the favor after the smuggler previously helped him fight a group of [[Kaleesh]] warriors. Zank was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the fight that ensued, much to [[Drooga]]'s entertainment.
